newsitem.title: UK: BT-MCI merger will create third global telecoms force.
newsitem.headline: BT-MCI merger will create third global telecoms force.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc shareholders Tuesday voted overwhelmingly in favour of a $20 billion international merger with MCI Communications Corp.
The merger, which would create a global force to rival two other major world telecommunications alliances, was approved by stockholders in Washington-based MCI two weeks ago.
The combined Anglo-American company, called Concert Plc, would compete with the Unisource group led by AT&T Corp., and GlobalOne, which includes Sprint Corp., Deutsche Telekom AG, and France Telecom.
Concert was expected to extend its reach even further by sweeping into Latin America through a deal with Portugal Telecom SA and a reported alliance with Telefonica de Espana SA.
Although BT confirmed its link with Portugal Telecom, it declined to confirm speculation about a deal between Concert and Telefonica, which is allied with AT&T's Unisource.
BT has been attempting to help fill the major hole in Concert's geographic jigsaw -- Asia -- by linking up with Japan's Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp.
